description: Carbacid (CO2) Limited is a liquefied carbon dioxide manufacturer. The Company, based in Kenya, manufactures and supplies carbon dioxide, gases and gas mixtures. It is engaged in production, purification and distribution. Carbacid's gases and gas supply equipment are used in applications such as scientific laboratories, refrigeration systems, aerosol propellant products, high technology medical and pharmaceutical processes, environmental emission control, and food processing. It develops solution-orientated customer partnerships. The Company's technical and application specialists offer advice and training in the safe handling and use of the products.
